I've been a long time user and fan of Oura, and I regularly go out of my way to tell my friends how great it is. Unfortunately, Oura has become so inaccurate lately that I am considering not using it anymore and will be using an alternative product. I was okay with this company collecting my health data for the tradeoff of having good insights into my health patterns, particularly my sleep, but Oura has become consistently terrible and its truly a shame because it used to be good.

Credit where it’s due: Of the many apps and gadgets I’ve used over the past decade, Oura’s sleep tracking is the closest match to my actual sleep experience and has actually helped me improve my sleep quality and duration. That makes it worthwhile to me. 

And now, the thing I’m putting up with in exchange for that bit of awesomeness: If you ever, ever use any app to log a yoga workout that has the usual savasana ending, this app will annoy you forever after. Every time you sit still for a straight 10 minutes or so, the app will “detect” a yoga workout and demand that you confirm it. If you use the in-app help to describe the problem and seek solutions, it will produce canned AI responses starting that there’s absolutely nothing you can do about it but the app will supposedly learn over time that it was wrong. 

The fecking app NEVER learns that it was wrong. 

And you can’t disable the danged workout detection feature. So get used to telling it 10+ times a day that you weren’t doing a yoga workout while you were lying in bed, driving your car, or sitting on the couch watching TV.

End of the world? Nope. Annoying enough to add a few extra stress minutes to your metrics daily? Def. Learn from my experience… don’t let your fitness trackers log savasana.
